title: Prospective cohort study to validate the standardised questionnaires PFDI-20 and PFIQ-7 in the German language for the objective assessment of quality of life and symptoms of women with pelvic floor prolapse
summary: This study aims to translate the most widely used international questionnaires on quality of life and symptoms in women with vaginal prolapse into German.

interventions.name: Adult patients with symptomatic pelvic floor prolapse (POPQ >= 2)

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
Symptomatic primary pelvic organ prolapse POPQ ≥ 2
Planned surgical treatment of pelvic organ prolapse
Declaration of consent
Exclusion criteria:
Limited cognitive, manual, or linguistic abilities to adequately complete the questionnaires in German
No surgical treatment of pelvic floor prolapse
Recurrence of pelvic floor prolapse
Lack of informed consent or capacity to give consent

sites.f: St. Hedwig Kliniken Berlin, KLinik für Urogynäkologie
